hyperedges.label: Visit Logging and Badge Reconcile Flow

nodes.label: XcodeGen-Generated Xcode Project
nodes.rationale: The .xcodeproj is a build artifact generated from project.yml; hand-edits would be lost, so xcodegen generate must be rerun after adding/removing/renaming source files.

nodes.label: Generated JSON Data Resources (bars/neighborhoods/zips/meta)
nodes.rationale: Data/Resources JSON files are build artifacts decoded once by AppData; the original legacy-expo pipeline is not in the working tree, so they are currently edited/regenerated directly with throwaway Python scripts. Precomputed barsById/barsByNeighborhood dictionaries exist to avoid linear scans.

nodes.label: Neighborhood Polygon Cleaning Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Polygons must be valid, simple, non-overlapping single rings. Pipeline order matters: buffer(0)-clean each input, then unary_union/difference, then simplify(~0.0003, preserve_topology=True), then set_precision(1e-6), then take largest exterior ring. Skipping the input clean or simplifying an invalid ring last leaves zero-width antennas that render as stray lines. bar.neighborhood is assigned by point-in-polygon with explicit user overrides for border bars (e.g. BASEMENT NY -> Williamsburg); polygon containment only drives map tap.

nodes.label: VisitsStore State and Persistence
nodes.rationale: Persists JSON to UserDefaults keys @gaybars/visits and @gaybars/visited. visitedIds is a cached stored @Published (not computed) for performance, so every new mutation must call refreshVisitedIds(). Backdated visits are stamped noon local so the ISO date round-trips the day key; future days are refused. A zero-drink check-in is a valid visit. Visit.dayKey is derived once at decode/create and never encoded.

nodes.label: BadgesStore Reconcile Pattern
nodes.rationale: BadgesStore is not self-subscribing: RootTabView calls badges.reconcile(visits:visitedIds:) on appear and via a single .onChange keyed on a combined ReconcileKey(visits, visitedBars) so one mutation triggers exactly one reconcile. Persists first-earned timestamps under @gaybars/badgeDates and drives the unlock-toast queue.

nodes.label: DayKey 0-Indexed Month Gotcha
nodes.rationale: Day keys use a 0-indexed month (mirrors JS getMonth() from the ported RN app), so June 24 2026 is 2026-5-24. All streak/badge/calendar logic depends on the DayKey.toDate noon-local round-trip; fixing the month to 1-indexed would silently break everything.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass: Chrome vs Panels Policy
nodes.rationale: Native .glassEffect is reserved for interactive chrome (search bars, toggles, tab bar, buttons, toasts) because glass draws a luminous rim that reads as a border on static content; stat cards, calendar, visit cards and badge tiles use plain contentPanel/white-5% rounded rects instead. Never put opacity on a glass element; AppBackground gradient must sit behind glass so it has colour to refract.
nodes.norm_label: liquid glass: chrome vs panels policy

nodes.label: RootTabView Paging Navigation Shell
nodes.rationale: Three pages in a horizontal paging ScrollView with a floating glass tab bar; the active-tab lozenge is placed by matchedGeometryEffect onto identical fixed-size content boxes (not manual offset math). pillPage is deliberately decoupled from page: taps snap the pill instantly while swipes spring it via onChange, and wrapping the tap pill-move in an animation is required or the matched-geometry pill flashes. TabSwipe disables paging in map mode and broadcasts the page so offscreen pages reset scroll to top invisibly.

nodes.label: Map Camera Framing and Snap-Back Logic
nodes.rationale: Selecting a neighborhood reframes the camera; zooming out past 1.2x the framed span snaps the filter back to All. The framed span must be the actual rendered span captured from the first onMapCameraChange after a reframe (awaitingFrame flag), because MapKit enlarges requested regions to fit wide/non-square bars - using the requested latitudeDelta made wide neighborhoods like East Williamsburg instantly snap back to All.
nodes.norm_label: map camera framing and snap-back logic

nodes.label: Simulator Screenshot and XCUITest Workflow
nodes.rationale: No SwiftUI Preview harness exists. Screenshots require temporary START_PAGE scaffolding that renders the target page directly, because programmatic scrollPosition(id:) writes outside a gesture silently no-op. The first-launch location alert is suppressed only by simctl privacy revoke (grant does not work). UI interaction requires a temporary bundle.ui-testing target with XCUITest attachments; App Store 6.5-inch shots use an iPhone 13 Pro Max sim at native 1284x2778 with a cleaned status bar.

nodes.label: NYC Gay Bars iOS App
nodes.rationale: Native Swift/SwiftUI port of an Expo/React Native app: browse bars in list or map, log drinks today or backdated, review history/stats/30 badges. Single-user and fully local by design - no accounts, no network at runtime.

nodes.label: Legacy-Expo Data Generation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Bar dataset, neighborhood polygons, and ZIP centroids are generated at build time (geocode-bars.mjs -> build-neighborhoods.mjs -> build-zips.mjs -> export-swift-data.mjs) and bundled as JSON so the app needs no map API key or network at runtime.

nodes.label: legacy-expo Archived RN App
nodes.rationale: The original Expo/React Native app, kept as the dataset's source of truth (gay_bars.csv + scripts/*.mjs); not part of the Xcode build.

nodes.label: NYCGayBars App Target (project.yml)
nodes.rationale: iOS 26 application target, bundle com.normanhoang.nycgaybars, iPhone-only (TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY 1), dark UI style, portrait only, ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false, Instagram in LSApplicationQueriesSchemes.

nodes.label: Location When-In-Use Permission Declaration
nodes.rationale: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: 'Used to show your distance to bars and sort them by proximity.'

nodes.label: Local-Only Data Storage Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Check-ins, drinks, history, and badges live only in on-device local storage; no server, no accounts, no analytics, no runtime network requests. Data is removed when the app is deleted.

nodes.label: On-Device-Only Location Use
nodes.rationale: Location, if granted, is used only on-device to show distance to bars and sort by proximity; never transmitted, stored, or shared, revocable at any time, and the app works without it.

nodes.label: Third-Party Instagram Link Handoff
nodes.rationale: Tapping a bar's social link may open Instagram; once the user leaves the app, the third party's privacy policy applies.

nodes.label: Support Page and FAQ
nodes.rationale: Support via normanhoang@gmail.com. FAQ notes: no internet needed; data is on-device only with no export/backup feature so it does not transfer to a new phone; bar additions/corrections requested by email.

nodes.label: App Store Connect Assets Page
nodes.rationale: Copy-paste kit for the ASC listing: name 'NYC Gay Bars', subtitle 'Track NYC's queer nightlife', SKU nycgaybars-001, Lifestyle/Travel categories, description, 97-char keywords, three 1284x2778 screenshots (map hero, stats, history), 1024px icon, and a submission checklist.

nodes.label: 'Data Not Collected' App Privacy Stance
nodes.rationale: Because location is used only on-device and never transmitted or stored off-device, it is not 'collected' under Apple's definition and must not be listed in the privacy questionnaire; select Data Not Collected, Tracking: No. Matches the shipped PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy (UserDefaults reason CA92.1).

nodes.label: 17+ Age Rating Expectation
nodes.rationale: The app is about bars and drink logging, so 'Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References' must be answered Frequent/Intense, which typically yields 17+; everything else is None and there is no login/UGC to trigger web-access flags.

nodes.label: Export Compliance via ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption
nodes.rationale: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false is set in Info.plist so App Store Connect will not prompt about encryption on upload.
